answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 27143 Country: Pakistan Title: I wanted to know that are we allowed to perform nafl salah in a moving car where the direction of qibla cannot be determined? Question: Assalamoalaykum, I wanted to know that are we allowed to perform nafl salah in a moving car where the direction of qibla cannot be determined? JazakAllah khair Answer ID: 27143 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2101/B=1698/tb=1431) Facing the Qiblah direction is one of the conditions of salah. If it is missing, salah will not be right. However, nafl salah can be performed in moving car. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
